facts.business: Meghna Infracon Infrastructure Limited is engaged in real estate development and infrastructure projects, primarily focused on residential redevelopment in Mumbai micro-markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company's focus for the coming years will be on progressing and monetising the existing project portfolio, converting the identified project pipeline into active developments, strengthening presence across selected Mumbai micro-markets, improving project execution and delivery efficiency, maintaining disciplined capital allocation, and building a scalable platform capable of generating sustainable long-term value.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Project portfolio monetisation and pipeline conversion

auditor.name: S K Dwivedi & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The company has not registered with the Employee Provident Fund Organization despite meeting the mandatory employee strength threshold, resulting in unquantified liability for PF contributions including interest/penalties. The company has not made any provision for gratuity as required under Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972 and Ind AS 19, leading to overstatement of net profit and understatement of provisions.

key_risks: Sales and rental realizations of projects driven by market conditions, nature and location of projects, brand, reputation and design
Non-compliance with EPF registration and gratuity provision requirements
facts.related_party_note: Remuneration revisions approved for Whole-time Directors Mr. Vikram Jayantilal Lodha (Rs. 4,00,000 p.m.) and Mrs. Meghna Vikram Lodha (Rs. 2,00,000 p.m.) with effect from 01st January 2026.
